metadata.description: Reusable constants for the Bright Data + n8n lead generation pipeline. Load this file once at workflow start using a Read Binary File node and reference its values in subsequent Set or Function nodes to avoid repeating magic strings inline.

state.description: The target Indian state for all search queries and output records.

stateCode.description: Two-letter ISO state code for Maharashtra.

country.description: The target country for all search queries and output records.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for India.

minimumBusinesses.description: Minimum number of businesses a query must return to be considered successful. Queries returning fewer results than this threshold are logged as low-yield.

blankIfMissing.description: When true, any output field that cannot be sourced from scraped or enriched data is left blank. The pipeline never fabricates or invents field values.

verifyPublicDataOnly.description: When true, the pipeline only collects and verifies data that is publicly available on Google Maps, business websites, or via Hunter.io domain search. No private data sources are used.

googleMapsSource.description: The canonical data source label written to the Data Source output column for records collected via Bright Data's Google Maps dataset.

websiteScraping.description: Controls whether the website scraping stage runs. When true, the workflow attempts to extract additional contact information from each business website using the Bright Data Web Unlocker zone.

hunterEnrichment.description: Controls whether the Hunter.io enrichment stage runs. When true, the workflow calls Hunter.io domain search and email finder for leads that have a website but no verified email.

totalCities.description: Total number of Maharashtra cities in cities.json.

totalCategories.description: Total number of search categories in categories.json.

totalSearchQueries.description: Total number of search query combinations: 149 cities × 26 categories.

queryIdFormat.description: Format string for the Query ID column in the output. Placeholders are replaced by the workflow using values from city_lookup.json and category_lookup.json.

outputFileNameTemplate.description: Template for the final output file name. The workflow replaces {timestamp} with an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at export time.

timezone.description: Timezone used for scheduling, logging, and all timestamp fields in the output.

neverFabricateData.description: Hard constraint. The pipeline must never invent, guess, or fabricate any business data including names, addresses, phones, emails, or websites. All values must be sourced from Bright Data or Hunter.io.
